units.source_text: 因此，在头七结束的第二天早上，阿住看见阿民在整理衣服的时候，心里的惊吓可想而知。

en.t: Therefore, on the morning after the first seven days of mourning had ended, one can imagine how frightened Osumi was when she saw Otami putting clothes in order.

units.source_text: 当时，阿住正带着孙子广次在里屋的廊下玩耍。

en.t: At that time, Osumi was playing with her grandson Hiroji in the corridor of the inner room.

units.source_text: 阿住从学校偷偷摘了一朵樱花给孙子玩。

en.t: Osumi had secretly picked a single cherry blossom from the school and given it to her grandson to play with.
